customer_host_feedback.visibility_limits: Only the visible portion of a single reply was available. The host model, hidden prompt, loading trace and remainder of the reply were not inspected.
fixes: Keep product identity disclosure in metadata and documentation; answer direct identity questions truthfully without adding an automatic preface to creative replies.
Develop the author's intended scene and emotion before critique; give concrete choices and conditional reasons.
Allow subjective memory, association and ellipsis; distinguish cinematic proposals from factual claims about real cognition.
Treat historical project exercises as optional context, not universal directing rules.

candidate_observations: No automatic identity preface in either creative opening.
Subjective memories and author-requested emotional direction developed into concrete scenes.
Public Waterland reading account was distinguished from newly proposed scene details.
tool_observations: Python launcher was unavailable in the trial environment; direct card reading was used.
One linked source timed out; the alternative linked primary source was accessible.
proxy_comparison.limits: Single generation per prompt in independent proxy agents; logical sessions share context within a candidate; not the WorkBuddy model, not human ratings, not a held-out general-quality result.
proxy_comparison.review_result: Both versions usable in these samples; reviewer slightly preferred the original 3.2.2 baseline. Current revision superiority not established.
remaining_observations: Candidate sometimes explained intended audience feelings too conclusively and repeated a full proposal after a short confirmation.
One user-specified sequence of multiple contributions was developed less fully than in the baseline.
One proposed action callback referred to a detail not explicitly established earlier.
proxy_comparison.patch_scope: Addresses the specific host opening and creative-stance failures; does not claim all remaining dialogue weaknesses are solved.

customer_host_feedback.public_data_boundary: Raw customer screenshot, prompt, and scene-specific comparison outputs stay local and are excluded from the public source allowlist.

claims_not_supported: Card count equals independent real Nolan experiences
Every registered source has been independently reverified in full
13 film entries are 13 films studied shot by shot
The new corpus has been used to train model weights
Passing offline tests proves conversational or creative quality
The current revision has passed customer WorkBuddy creative acceptance
Positive proxy-agent reviews outweigh a real customer-host failure

software_validation.scope: offline retrieval, attribution, source export boundaries, package integrity

independent_dialogue_trials.limits: small samples; logical sessions share one agent context per cohort; no human blind ratings, voice evaluation, customer-host model comparison or general accuracy claim

coverage_limits: Structured self-report cards cover only a subset of the source registry; other cards mix research summaries and applications.
No complete verified reading history or complete film/scene analysis is available.
New passage-reviewed cards overlap with old concepts; the current build is not a corpus deduplication study.
Independent AI trials were run; no held-out old/new comparison on the customer model has been run.
MIT and NOTICE define authored-content scope; third-party works remain separately attributed; no public repository has been published.
